Where We Sail

Five oceans' worth of itineraries, one phone call

On an average 7-day cruise you can visit at least three different countries or islands — while unpacking only once. Add a pre- or post-cruise land stay and explore your favorite port a few days longer. Tap a destination to start planning it.

The LJ Difference

Your agent doesn't wave from the dock. She sails with you.

Lucy Jones has been in travel for over 26 years and opened LJ Cruise Vacation in 1999. Before that she organized bus trips, church picnics and employee outings — and founded her workplace's first employee association, running ski trips, casino trips and cruises as its president. Planning group travel is simply what she does.

  • She travels with the group — on many sailings Lucy is on board, ensuring the highest possible service with attention to every detail.
  • Nobody gets left behind — when an airline tried to split her Alaska group at Vancouver Airport, Lucy refused: everyone flew home together, as ticketed. Her job ends when you're safely home.
  • First-hand knowledge — 30+ cruises sailed, 10 years lived abroad, extensive Caribbean travel. You're advised by someone who has been where you're going.
  • Here 24 hours a day — questions before you sail, help while you're away. One call reaches a person who knows your trip by name.

"When we got to the ship I was surprised to find my cabin decorated nicely in blue & white for our Anniversary, and the wine was waiting on ice. I give honor to God for giving you, Lucy, the ability, knowledge, wisdom and strength to be a Great Cruise Agent!"

— Eltrice D., LJ Cruise Vacation client
Groups & Occasions

If your people gather, a cruise gathers them better

There are a thousand different reasons to take a cruise — all of them good. These are the ones Lucy plans most.

Church Groups

Fellowship sailings and church holiday cruises — the group travel Lucy started with, organizing trips for her own church and block association long before she opened the agency.

School Outings

Class trips and school group sailings with the supervision, structure and pricing schools need — every student accounted for, there and back.

Families & Reunions

Family cruises and reunions across generations — cabins near each other, activities for every age, and family discounts that make bringing everyone realistic.

Company Cruises

Business meetings at sea, sales incentives and company outings — a working venue your team will actually thank you for, planned around your agenda.

Weddings & Honeymoons

Marry on board, or exchange vows at a port stop and honeymoon on the cruise — with cabins decorated and the wine on ice when you arrive.

Celebrations & Fundraisers

Birthdays and anniversaries done big — and cruises as effective fundraisers, where every cabin booked supports your cause.

Group discounts. Family discounts. Any-cruise discounts.

Bringing a group is where a specialist earns her keep — blocked cabins, group rates and perks a booking website won't offer you. Tell Lucy how many are sailing and she'll hunt the discount.

How Booking Works

Three steps between you and the gangway

1

Tell Lucy the dream

Call 866-245-2900 or send the form below — where you want to go, who's coming, and roughly when. Individuals, families and whole congregations welcome.

2

She matches ship & sailing

Lucy compares the world's leading cruise lines for your dates, hunts group and family discounts, and arranges flights, cabins and pre- or post-cruise land stays as one plan.

3

Sail — she's a call away

On group sailings Lucy often travels with you. Either way she's here 24 hours a day, and her job isn't done until everyone is home safe.
